purpose: Bind supplied static GLB target evidence to exact bytes and independent job requirements; identify owning professions for unresolved evidence.

properties.path: existing GLB artifact; read-only, outside protected machine state, without symbolic links
properties.target: job's expected engine, optional version, and context; must match packet exactly
properties.required_lanes: job's non-empty target requirements; packet cannot remove these requirements

relationships: reuses the existing static asset target evidence validator
profession crews reobserve the artifact and do not train from supplied target declarations
limitations: No engine, collision, navigation, visual review or device benchmark is executed.
Evidence sources are not opened, authenticated or independently reproduced.
PASS means packet adequacy, exact artifact binding and matching job requirements only.
No professional acceptance, visual quality or crew experience is granted.
